user.title: Heat Pump Supply Temperature Optimizer
user.description: Select your local inputs and rooms, or import a private configuration profile. This integration provides advice and never sends equipment commands.

heat_pump.title: Heat pump inputs
heat_pump.description: Select measured heat and electrical power separately. Units are validated at runtime; unavailable sensors are retried.

environment.title: Outside temperatures and other heat sources
environment.description: The heating curve and the demand/COP model can use different outside sensors. Weather is only required for price forecasts.

data.local_outdoor: Local outside temperature for COP and demand

electricity.title: Electricity and PV inputs
electricity.description: Household import/export is used to estimate other load and available PV, not as the heat pump electricity measurement.

data.import_power: Household grid import power (for price optimization)

providers.title: Forecast providers
providers.description: For Forecast.Solar, select one entity from each installation; its integration entry is resolved automatically. Generic forecasts use entity attributes described in the README.

data.outlet_dhw_fallback: If mode is missing, assume DHW above 40°C outlet

model.title: Local heat-demand and COP model
model.description: Defaults are uncalibrated engineering examples. Replace them with your own coefficients and set confirmed to true before enabling price reduction. Keep confirmed false for efficiency-only use.

advanced.title: Advanced parameters
advanced.description: Provider attribute keys, curve rounding, DHW values and equipment limits. No entity names belong in this JSON.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Add any number of rooms. The list determines the room count.

add_room.title: Add room
add_room.description: Select either one climate entity OR both separate actual/setpoint entities. {detail}

data.name: Name
data.enabled: Include this room in comfort checks
data.climate: Climate entity (or use the two sensors below)

room_details.title: Edit room
room_details.description: Room identity and history are preserved when its name changes. {detail}

data.name: Name
data.enabled: Include this room in comfort checks
data.climate: Climate entity (or use the two sensors below)

import_profile.title: Import private local profile
import_profile.description: Paste the local JSON profile. Room names, source entities and calibration remain in this HA instance.

error.invalid_configuration: Invalid configuration. Check the selected entities, room source types, curve limits and JSON values.
error.invalid_json: Enter a valid JSON object using the documented keys.
